maya: Proposal: add opt-in rollforward header so clients can be auto-routed to v2 during v1 deprecations. thoughts on console UX + telemetry + billing?
kevin: header vs tenant-level flag? e.g. `X-Rollforward: consent` or API-key metadata?
sophie: both. header for per-app control, console/API-key metadata for key-level default. show status in dashboard.
ranjit: telemetry: we need events `rollforward_attempt`, `rollforward_success`, `rollforward_fallback` with model_variant, latency_ms, and sample_rate. start sampling at 5%.
liz: enterprise/Dedicated should default OFF; require whitelist opt-in. also need audit logs for automatic decisions.
sophie: billing: shadowing v2 must not bill twice. proposal: only charge active routed target. shadow traces emit token-estimates but not billed. ops sign-off needed.
kevin: fallback rules: if v2 5xx or latency > v1 +1500ms, fallback to v1 for next N requests (N=10) with exponential backoff. surface circuit-breaker in console.
maya: decision sketch: header + api-key metadata + console toggle; telemetry events sampled 5%; shadow free; enterprise default off; circuit-breaker N=10; audit logs include tenant_id + request_id. Owners: ranjit (telemetry, due 2024-08-30), kevin (billing doc, due 2024-08-25), sophie (console + key metadata, due 2024-08-28), liz (compliance/audit, due 2024-08-29).
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: rollforward-consent v0.1 -> staging 2024-09-12 03:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: canary created (5% tenants).

sophie: +1
